budget_items.topic: State earmark request for pump stations
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The $300K sewer pump station upgrade request is on the State Earmark list; the list's other items are also printed.
budget_items.quote: the list consists of security upgrades at turkey hill elementary and the primary schools ($374.5k), marshall park ($250k), library exterior painting ($36k) and $300k for sewer pump stations.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Leominster charges $1,000 per connection versus $750 for Lunenburg; Leominster wants to raise its charge to $1,250.
budget_items.quote: currently, leominster charges $1,000 for connections, but only $750 to lunenburg. they want to increase the charge to $1,250.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Budget changes as presented: expenditures and indirect costs, deficit, and retained earnings transfers to OPEB and Capital Reserve.
budget_items.quote: changes to the budget are as follows: expenditures & indirect costs- $1,439,402.82, deficit-$218,690.42, retained earnings transfers- $1,000 to opeb and $36,621.37 to capital reserve.

budget_items.topic: Fitchburg usage and fringe benefit increases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg usage added $6,600 and health insurance/retirement benefits added $8,631.53, funded by moving $15,231.53 out of Capital Expenditures.
budget_items.quote: paula added $6,600 to fitchburg usage and $8,631.53 for health insurance/retirement benefits for barb.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The budgeted 4% Fitchburg usage increase is expected to be replaced by rate increases of 7% per year for the next 5 years.
budget_items.quote: she said barb had budgeted 4% increase for fitchburg usage but they will probably be increasing rates

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Retained Earnings appropriation needed, matching the figure published in the warrant.
